import urllib.request
import json

# Check HGNC for HGNC:4497
req = urllib.request.Request("https://rest.genenames.org/fetch/hgnc_id/4497", headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
    data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    docs = data['response']['docs'][0]
    print("HGNC symbol:", docs.get('symbol'))
    print("HGNC name:", docs.get('name'))
    print("Alias symbol:", docs.get('alias_symbol'))
    print("Prev symbol:", docs.get('prev_symbol'))

# Check NCBI Gene 2867
req2 = urllib.request.Request("https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id=2867&retmode=json")
with urllib.request.urlopen(req2) as resp:
    data2 = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    print("NCBI Gene 2867:", data2['result']['2867']['name'], data2['result']['2867']['description'])
